remarks: Move right into this totally renovated townhouse in desirable Orchard Hills with three bedrooms and three and a half baths. End unit with lovely private patio and gardens not far from the attractive heated pool. The kitchen with granite counters and upscale appliances is a chef's delight with eating island and is open to the dining area and living room with fireplace and custom built-ins. French doors open to the picturesque private flagstone patio and garden area. Two oversized bedroom suites are located on the second floor and the lower level has a family room, bedroom suite with large walk-in closet and large laundry room. Many recent improvements including new furnace and front walkway. Close to scenic Mead Park, with concession stand, tennis /pickle ball courts, and play ground. The commuter train, grocery stores and farmers market are close by. Enjoy living in the heart of New Canaan with fashionable shops, award winning restaurants, schools and library.
